QF.id: VII Market Participants in Securities Markets_42

question.text: Section 43 of PMLA empowers the Central Government to designate which courts for trial of money laundering offences?

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 43 of PMLA empowers the Central Government to designate one or more Courts of Session as Special Courts for the trial of money laundering offences. Separately, Sections 41-42 deal with appeals to the High Court against Appellate Tribunal decisions. The Trap: Trials happen in Sessions Courts designated as Special Courts; the High Court appellate role under Sections 41-42 is against Appellate Tribunal decisions, not against the Special Courts. Note: Pages 52-56 support the Section 43 Special Court designation and the Sections 41-42 High Court appellate route from Appellate Tribunal decisions; a Special Court to Appellate Tribunal to High Court hierarchy is not stated in the pages checked.
